# STRVCT

> Write the domain model. Get the application.

Site build: STRVCT · 2026-11-13 · 40fde13f

## Documentation

- [Documentation](/docs/): Guides, architecture, and API reference.
- [Accessibility](/docs/Accessibility/): Automatic, framework-level ARIA support, keyboard navigation, and preference adaptation derived from slot metadata annotations and view classes.
- [Comparing to React](/docs/Comparing%20to%20React/): A guide to Strvct for developers who know React.
- [Diagrams](/docs/Diagrams/): Architectural sketches of the Strvct framework. Working drafts; not yet placed in their final locations within the docs.
- [Annotations](/docs/Diagrams/Annotations/)
- [Diagram Conventions](/docs/Diagrams/Conventions/): Style and layout rules for the SVG diagrams used throughout the Strvct docs.
- [Layers](/docs/Diagrams/Layers/)
- [Persistence Pipeline](/docs/Diagrams/Persistence%20Pipeline/)
- [View ↔ Model ↔ Storage Syncing](/docs/Diagrams/Sync%20Flow/)
- [View Resolution](/docs/Diagrams/View%20Resolution/)
- [Events and Gestures](/docs/Events%20and%20Gestures/): Event flow, listeners, gesture recognizers, timers, keyboard handling, and drag-and-drop.
- [Drag and Drop](/docs/Events%20and%20Gestures/Drag%20and%20Drop/): Browser drag-and-drop support for views and nodes, covering drop targets, drag sources, and MIME-type dispatch.
- [Event Flow](/docs/Events%20and%20Gestures/Event%20Flow/): The end-to-end path from a browser event to an application handler.
- [Event Listeners](/docs/Events%20and%20Gestures/Event%20Listeners/): Thin wrappers around native DOM events that forward to handler methods on views.
- [Gesture Recognizers](/docs/Events%20and%20Gestures/Gesture%20Recognizers/): Higher-level state machines that interpret sequences of events as meaningful gestures.
- [Keyboard and Focus](/docs/Events%20and%20Gestures/Keyboard%20and%20Focus/): Keyboard state tracking, modifier-aware key dispatch, and the responder chain for focus management.
- [Timers](/docs/Events%20and%20Gestures/Timers/): Managed timeout system for scheduling deferred work, with support for weak references to avoid preventing garbage collection.
- [Getting Started](/docs/Getting%20Started/): Setup, integration, directory conventions, build pipeline, and running your first Strvct application.
- [Implementation Overview](/docs/Implementation%20Overview/): Deep technical specifications for class lifecycle, slots, views, persistence, notifications, and build infrastructure.
- [Inspectors and Debugging](/docs/Inspectors%20and%20Debugging/): Built-in tools for live Property Inspection, Developer Mode graph toggles, and Chrome DevTools source debugging.
- [Inspirations](/docs/Inspirations/): Frameworks and ideas that shaped STRVCT's design.
- [Internationalization](/docs/Internationalization/): AI-powered translation of UI text with per-language IndexedDB persistence, batched requests, and content filtering.
- [Lifecycle](/docs/Lifecycle/): Boot sequence, node initialization, view synchronization, and persistence cycles.
- [App Lifecycle](/docs/Lifecycle/App%20Lifecycle/): SvApp singleton initialization sequence, extension points, runtime environment hooks, user alert routing, and UI readiness promises.
- [Boot Sequence](/docs/Lifecycle/Boot%20Sequence/): How the application loads from first script tag to a running app.
- [Headless Execution](/docs/Lifecycle/Headless%20Execution/): Running STRVCT applications natively in Node.js without DOM or browser dependencies.
- [Node Lifecycle](/docs/Lifecycle/Node%20Lifecycle/): Creation, three-phase initialization, parent-child relationships, and update notifications.
- [Persistence Lifecycle](/docs/Lifecycle/Persistence%20Lifecycle/): How objects are stored, loaded, and kept in sync with the local record store and the cloud.
- [View Synchronization](/docs/Lifecycle/View%20Synchronization/): How views discover nodes, synchronize state, and batch updates efficiently.
- [Naked Objects](/docs/Naked%20Objects/): From Domain Models to Complete Applications
- [Naked Objects](/docs/Naked%20Objects%20Old/): From Domain Models to Complete Applications
- [Nodes](/docs/Nodes/): The core domain object abstraction, object graph hierarchy, and subnode management in Strvct.
- [Notifications](/docs/Notifications/): Event-driven communication between framework layers using observations, scheduling, and weak references.
- [Broadcaster](/docs/Notifications/Broadcaster/): Immediate, synchronous event broadcasting across object trees in SvBroadcaster.
- [Notification Center](/docs/Notifications/Notification%20Center/): Asynchronous event dispatching, dual WeakMap observation indexing, and decoupled change propagation in SvNotificationCenter.
- [Slot Change Hooks](/docs/Notifications/Slot%20Change%20Hooks/): Declarative lifecycle hooks invoked automatically during slot mutation.
- [Sync Scheduler](/docs/Notifications/Sync%20Scheduler/): Coalescing, deduplication, and event-loop-deferred method execution in SvSyncScheduler.
- [Persistence](/docs/Persistence/): Local storage, cloud sync, and blob management for object graphs.
- [Cloud Object Pools](/docs/Persistence/Cloud%20Object%20Pools/): Cloud persistence for object pools: one record per row, a version per pool, and an atomic commit protocol.
- [Local and Cloud Blob Storage](/docs/Persistence/Local%20and%20Cloud%20Blob%20Storage/): SHA-256 content-addressable binary asset storage for images, audio, video, and files.
- [Local Object Pools](/docs/Persistence/Local%20Object%20Pools/): IndexedDB-backed persistence for domain object graphs using dirty tracking, the local record store (SvLocalRecordStore), and atomic event-loop commits.
- [Plans](/docs/Plans/): Design ideas, architectural directions, and planned improvements, with a meta plan for the order to do them in.
- [Accessibility Testing & Tuning](/docs/Plans/Accessibility%20Testing%20%26%20Tuning/)
- [Async Final Initialization](/docs/Plans/Async%20Final%20Initialization/)
- [Async Navigation](/docs/Plans/Async%20Navigation/): Rearchitecting the navigation stack to support asynchronous loading at every level.
- [Browser Cleanup](/docs/Plans/Browser%20Cleanup/)
- [Capabilities & Permissions](/docs/Plans/Capabilities%20%26%20Permissions/)
- [Case Studies](/docs/Plans/Case%20Studies/)
- [Cleanup Notes](/docs/Plans/Cleanup%20Notes/)
- [Complete Protocols](/docs/Plans/Complete%20Protocols/)
- [Emergent Capabilities](/docs/Plans/Emergent%20Capabilities/)
- [Graph Database](/docs/Plans/Graph%20Database/)
- [JSON Schema](/docs/Plans/JSON%20Schema/)
- [Lazy Slots](/docs/Plans/Lazy%20Slots/)
- [Meta Plan](/docs/Plans/Meta%20Plan/): The order to do the other plans in, why, and what should change in them first.
- [Naked Objects Issues](/docs/Plans/Naked%20Objects%20Issues/)
- [Promise-Wrapped Slots](/docs/Plans/Promise-Wrapped%20Slots/)
- [Tile Container Views](/docs/Plans/Tile%20Container%20Views/)
- [Tile Views](/docs/Plans/Tile%20Views/)
- [Programming Idioms](/docs/Programming%20Idioms/): Recurring patterns and conventions for writing STRVCT code.
- [Async Patterns](/docs/Programming%20Idioms/Async%20Patterns/): Promise extensions, serial and parallel async array iteration, and error context rethrowing with Error.rethrow().
- [Categories](/docs/Programming%20Idioms/Categories/): Extending existing classes by adding methods from separate files without subclassing.
- [Protocols](/docs/Programming%20Idioms/Protocols/): Declaring interfaces and verifying conformance at runtime with fail-fast registration checks.
- [Style Guide](/docs/Programming%20Idioms/Style%20Guide/): Coding conventions, self-initializing class patterns, method chaining, and file structure rules across STRVCT.
- [Reference](/docs/Reference/): Class hierarchy, module hierarchy, and protocol definitions.
- [Classes](/docs/Reference/Classes/)
- [Modules](/docs/Reference/Modules/)
- [Protocols](/docs/Reference/Protocols/)
- [Services](/docs/Services/): AI, cloud, media, and IoT service integrations.
- [AI Services](/docs/Services/AI%20Services/): Framework architecture for multi-provider AI integration, streaming execution, tool calling, and model-first operability.
- [Cloud Storage](/docs/Services/Cloud%20Storage/): Firebase integration for cloud persistence and file storage.
- [Home Assistant](/docs/Services/Home%20Assistant/): IoT device control via Home Assistant's WebSocket API.
- [Media](/docs/Services/Media/): YouTube audio playback and browser speech recognition.
- [Proxies](/docs/Services/Proxies/): Client-side proxy configuration for routing API calls through intermediary servers.
- [Slots](/docs/Slots/): The property system: declaration, slot annotations, runtime type checks, lifecycle hooks, and metadata consumers.
- [Technical Overview](/docs/Technical%20Overview/): High-level architecture, core design philosophy, and system-wide concepts of the Strvct framework.
- [Views](/docs/Views/): The view layer: auto-generated UI, custom views, and programmatic styling.
- [Auto-Generated Views](/docs/Views/Auto-Generated%20Views/): How the view layer connects to model nodes, resolves view classes, synchronizes state, and provides navigation without hand-authored UI code.
- [Companion View](/docs/Views/Companion%20View/): A persistent secondary context docked alongside a node's navigation, collapsing behind an edge handle or disappearing as the viewport narrows.
- [Custom Views](/docs/Views/Custom%20Views/): Authoring custom view classes, DOM wrappers, flex shortcuts, and model synchronization for specialized media.
- [Programmatic Styling](/docs/Views/Programmatic%20Styling/): Named CSS methods, the chainable API, and why STRVCT avoids CSS files.
- [Responsive Views](/docs/Views/Responsive/): Automatic viewport compaction, last-column stretching, and per-node width hooks without per-screen layout code.
- [Themes and Style States](/docs/Views/Themes%20and%20Style%20States/): How views resolve their appearance from theme classes, style states, and node configuration.
